newsitem.title: USA: Argosy sees Ind. casino partly open in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Argosy sees Ind. casino partly open in Q3.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said it expects to take delivery of its new riverboat casino and put it in limited operation at its temporary docking site in Indiana late in the third quarter.

"These plans only contemplate operating the casino at approximately two-third capacity ... The new riverboat casino will not be utilized at full capacity until Phase I of the company's permanent site opens in December 1997," Argosy said.
The company reported a second-quarter net loss of $4.3 million, compared to a year-ago net loss of $4.8 million. Revenues on the quarter rose to $87.5 million from $63.3 million, the company said.
